name: print-social-white-and-electric-blue-we-are-here-to-give-you-advice-text-slide
title: We Are Here to Give You Advice Text Slide
whatItIs: A white carousel slide with blue bars top and bottom, a ticket logo, a small blue tag 'A NOTE FIRST', a huge black heavy 'WE ARE HERE TO GIVE YOU' and a blue 'ADVICE.', and three short centred lines with bold key phrases.
whatItMeans: A single electric blue accent word in a black headline makes a text-only slide punchy, and plain lines below keep it conversational.
techniques: One blue word in a black headline
Small blue tag above the headline
Bold key phrases inside light body lines
Faint slide counter in a corner

vocabulary.definition: A word set in a colour that differs from the headline.
A small label above a heading.
A slide relying on type without images.
